output:

Replying to: none

PIN NUMBER RECEIVED!!! 🎉🙏 And I am crying by the kettle, so bear with me.

Mga kaibigan, I need to shout about my best friend today. @Lorna Villaruz — my sister from another mother — her NMC PIN came through today!!! After the IELTS, the CBT, the OSCE, the waiting waiting waiting, she is officially a registered nurse in the UK. And she is coming HERE. To Liverpool. After 20 years of me telling her to come haha. She finally listened.

Lorna and me, we trained together in nursing school in Iloilo. 1996, our capping ceremony, same hairstyle, same dream. In our dorm we polished our white shoes every single night — and she always borrowed my polish. Never bought her own. Not once. Twenty-something years and I am still not over it 😂 Lorna, you know it is true.

She went to Riyadh, then Dubai — almost 18 years working away from home, away from her family, and now she is finally coming to us. She lands on 14 January, Dubai to Manchester, around 1pm. And she starts on 25 January on Ward 7 medical at Mersey Bank Hospital, induction first then her preceptorship. Ward 7, listen to me. You are getting the best nurse I know. Calm, kind, never rattled, the patients love her. Lucky lucky ward.

She will stay with us the first month — the spare room is getting cleared (sorry Andrea, your boxes are moving), the heater is ready, Ben says ok. And she is bringing dried mangoes and Bicol pili for Tito Ben, so everybody is happy haha.

When I left for the UK in 2004 she cried at the airport and said "susunod ako, I will follow you." 22 years later. She kept her word, that one. She did her OSCE in Nottingham and I sent her a photo of the rain so she knows exactly what she is getting into 😂

Lorna, bring a proper coat. A PROPER one. Not the one from Divisoria. Liverpool wind is no joke, I have said this to the new nurses and I am saying it to you — Primark or TK Maxx, we will sort you out the first week.

Welcome to our Filipino family here, anak. The Christmas parties, the potluck, the raffle tickets, all of it. And Simbang Gabi next year you are coming with us, 6pm at St Teresa's, nine nights, no excuses, Ben will drive.

God is good. I am so happy I cannot even type properly. Welcome home in advance, Lorna. See you at Manchester airport in January with a coat in my hand ❤️❤️❤️
